posts.author: JustKira
posts.body:
Hello! My name is Kira and I'm kind of new to the RPG Maker MV. I've been using it for several months and although it was a lot of fun I have some complaints...
And the core of my complaints lies in the "visuals and image rendering"
The first thing I noticed while making a game is the fact that it starts in a small window. No big deal! Just press the full screen button. But when I tried it my game started to look all blury. Alright, after some research I thought I found the solution. Not only did I installed a plugin for a true fullscreen but also someone suggested adding some lines of code into my games index file.
<style type="text/css"> CANVAS{image-rendering: pixelated;}
<style type="text/css"> CANVAS{image-rendering: pixelated;}</style>
(The code)
But it brought even more problems!!! The pixel sprites were all messed up. Pixels weren't their true size were really ugly and were messing up the looks of sprites. Not only that, but the text went blury and became even uglier. I tried various plugins and additions but none of them would work!!!
How come this problem isn't even remotely talked about? All of the games that I've seen that we're made in the rpg maker looked amazing and didn't have any of the problems that I've met...
I don't know what to do, If any of you can help me, or know how to deal with any of the problems please I will be very grateful!
